nom: Ahava Purifying Mud Mask Detoxify & Purify

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin describe it drawing out excess oil and blackheads, from T-zone congestion to very oily, thick skin that needs a longer application time to work; one oily-skin reviewer found it no more effective on her blemishes than her regular face wash.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: some report it smooths dry patches and doesn't dry them out further as long as they moisturize right after, while others with dry or rosacea-prone skin say it irritated their face, worsened redness, and dried them out.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin — oily in the T-zone with drier cheeks — describe it evening out both areas at once, soaking up oil, smoothing dry patches, and calming redness in breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Reports from sensitive-skin reviewers diverge sharply: several describe burning, a rash, or worse redness after one or two uses, while others with sensitive or reactive skin, including one who worried beforehand, say it caused no irritation and cleared breakouts overnight.
segments.normal: The one reviewer with normal-to-combination skin found it a quick, refreshing mask, though she wasn't certain it did anything for her early fine lines or occasional breakouts after a single use.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who frames her skin as over 50 credits the mask, used on clogged and enlarged pores on her dermatologist's recommendation, as part of what keeps her skin looking younger.

concerns.aging: Evidence here is thin: one reviewer with early fine lines wasn't sure after a single use whether the mask affected them, while another in her fifties credits it as part of a routine that keeps her skin looking younger; neither reports a specific change to wrinkles.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with oily or combination skin, say it does not dry their skin out or only mildly so; a few with dry or sensitive skin disagree, reporting it dried them out or recommending a moisturizer applied right after.
concerns.redness: Reviewers describe it calming redness from picked or inflamed breakouts and from general reactivity, including one who says she gets red very easily; two reviewers with dry, sensitive, or rosacea-prone skin instead report it worsened their redness and irritation.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers say it faded dark marks and old acne scars with regular use, alongside its main breakout-clearing effect.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers, many describing themselves as acne- or breakout-prone, report clearer skin, smaller pores and pimples reduced within a day or overnight; a few disagree, saying they saw no change after weeks of regular use, or that it dried pimples out only for them to reappear the next morning.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin, including some with very oily or thick skin, report it draws out excess oil and controls shine, from the T-zone to the whole face; no reviewer reports it failing to reduce oiliness.

extraits.texte: I have sensitive skin. Used this for the first time and it BURNS my skin.

I would not recommend this product for dry skin, sensitive skin and certainly not rosacea skin. I had used clay masks in the past that actually helped with the redness from my rosacea but this irritated my face and made it worse. I think this would probably work well for normal or oily skin but if you are the least bit sensitive I would stay away.

extraits.titre: Ok Face Mask. Great for Deep Exfoliating!
extraits.texte: I purchased this in my quest of finding a great mud mask that can draw out impurities, help with acne blemishes and control oil. Well this one isn't that. I applied the mask and after a few minutes it dried down almost invisible on my skin. When I wet my face to remove the mask using my hands, it reactived the mask into a creamy, exfoliating lather. After I washed it off, my face felt clean and that's it. Didn't help with blemishes and it controlled my oily skin like when wash my face with Philosophy Purity face wash. This mask is great for people with normal skin with no skin issues looking for a basic mask. If you're looking for more, this isn't it.

I only tried the sample size for one-time use so I can't speak to the mask's effectiveness over time. I have normal to combination skin, with some clogged pores and early fine lines, occasional breakouts. This mask is quick and refreshing. It goes on thick and creamy and spreads easily. Right away I could feel a cooling, almost tingling sensation under the mask that lasted until I rinsed it off. It's gentle, though, and not at all burning or uncomfortable. I considered leaving the mask on longer to dry but decided to go ahead and rinse. Takes a bit to rinse completely off and felt best with semi-cool water. Once my skin dried though my complexion appeared refreshed and clear. Not sure if this would be moisturizing or plumping for fine lines/wrinkles or if it would really help smooth clogged pore bumps.

Serious people...best mud/non-sheet face mask I have ever used (and I've tried a lot from cheap to very expensive). The one downside to mud/cream masks is the wait time, BUT this mask only takes 2-5 mins. max for this baby to produce results!! I received the trial size in my ipsy glam bag this month and was skeptical at first due to my very sensitive skin. However, this mask was perfect for my combination skin. I have oily skin with acne issues in the t-zone and chin with super dry areas where acne is healing. I used this mask on those "problem" areas while shaving my legs. The instructions say leave on for 2 mins....it actually was almost totally dry at 2 mins. When rinsing it off I scrubbed the mask in gentle circular motions over my entire face and neck for a quick exfoliation before rinsing completely off. The following morning when i woke up the massive breakout that was just starting on my forehead was gone! Almost all the acne bumps were GONE! I Would for sure recommend this to a friend...actually I already have but I'd also recommend this to anyone who suffers from acne, blackheads, whiteheads, or just needs a good pore detox/ quick but effevtive pamper shes. I will for sure be purchasing the fill size bottle on payday. I've actually used it twice now and its been preventing new acne from even showing up to the party...yay!! 10/10 nailed it with this mud mask! my search may finally be over thanks to ipsy and this product being in my glam bag! samples are Great, I know

I have been looking for a green mud mask that doesn't overdry or irritate my skin. I have used Ahava products in the past and feel they are a trustworthy brand. The price was reasonable as well. My skin has an oily t-zone with acne on the chin periodically and dry cheeks. This product smoothed out my dry area, soaked up the oily areas and shrunk/diminshed the redness in the breakouts. Also, the product comes of easily with warm washcloth. My skin was non-irritated and I get red very easily so that is proof enough for me.

extraits.titre: Great mask to purify and clear  any enlarged pores
extraits.texte: Recommended by my dermatologist. I use it only on areas where I tend to have slightly enlarged pores or clogged pores. It's not as harsh as others I had tried. Part of how I keep my over 50 skin looking years younger.
